summary: The ui_open test server keeps its store in a file, as the daemon does: its attention and roster publishers write while a seat asks from its own process, and on a shared-memory store the two met with SQLITE_LOCKED, so st work ask in the alert test failed its first try with 503 database-locked.

rules.detail: No rule, permission or trust change.

compatibility.detail: No wire, CLI or client change.

downtime.detail: Nothing runs differently on installed machines.
